title: alchemilla palmata subsp. heteropoda
intro: Alchemilla palmata subsp. heteropoda, commonly known as Lady's Mantle or Alpine Lady's Mantle, is a flowering plant species within the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and acting as a natural diuretic. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla palmata subsp. heteropoda include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent properties, which may help soothe and protect the skin and mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
